title: How a Kid From Croatia Ended Up Running Bugatti
description:
A professor in Zagreb reportedly told him that building a car in Croatia was impossible. At twenty-one he started a car company anyway. At thirty-three he became the chief executive of Bugatti. This is the story of Mate Rimac, the boy who was bullied for his accent, and how he ended up running one of the most famous car brands on Earth. Here is the twist. His company almost did not survive its first big offer. A rich buyer wanted two of his cars, and the only price was moving the company abroad. He said no, lost his only investors, and later called it the best thing he had ever done.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
